description: A transmission carrying data to two peers goes at the lower of their rungs, by ladder order, so it never exceeds either peer's MAX-SPEED.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED (A-0041, A-0047). At 1500, during a burst, it sends S_UNIDATA_REQUEST (priority 0, SAP 5, DELIVERY MODE default, TTL 0, so TTD 1500 + 1296000000 ms, no confirmation): no SIS output (A-0095), dts.ttd starts (C-1050). At 2000 the burst's one block holds PADDING D_PDUs (type 14) to 0.0.1.2, EOT 10, each carrying one EOW; the PADDING itself is ignored (C-0588). A CAPABILITY with the Ed4 bit records its sender Ed4 (interp C-1261). Burst end 3000: csma.vdcd_end 4000; at 7000 LBT rule 1 (K-0067, K-0068), seed 0 slot 15, CONT_WAIT 45000 (K-0080). The transmit queue empties, so dts.ttd is cancelled (C-1050). Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150; per rung the block bytes and ms given in the config (test data). The DATA C_PDU holds the DATA S_PDU SAP 5 to SAP 5 with its TTD; each type 7 has address size 3, and its EOT and reception window are the half seconds from the start of its block to the end of the burst, rounded up (C-0104, C-0350, C-1043). drc.table (corpus-format.md 6.1): ladder WN 2 Long, WN 4 Long, WN 4 Short, WN 6 Long (positions 0 to 3); no thresholds, so this node's own MAX-SPEED and LOW-SPEED never get a value (corpus-format.md 6.2 step 6) and the mixed rotation it sends each Ed4 peer it has heard is MAX-SEGMENT 255 alone (0xAFF; no SENDER-APPROACH has come, C-0956; interp C-1271, C-1272), with no top priority; sender constants tx_step_down_waits 2, tx_ceiling_initial 2, tx_ceiling_cap 4. The burst holds CAPABILITY and MAX-SPEED WN 6 Long (0x8A6) from 0.0.1.3, then CAPABILITY and MAX-SPEED WN 4 Long (0x885) from 0.0.1.4, all to 0.0.1.2 and recorded per sender (interp C-1262). Conn 1 sends 'hello' to 0.0.1.3 and then 'hi' to 0.0.1.4, both at 1500, so both C_PDUs share a TTD. One transmission carries both (C_PDU IDs 0 and 1, by age, C-0853); its rung is the lowest over the addressees by ladder order (C-0894, C-0930; open question 6, interp C-1283): WN 4 Long (position 1), below WN 6 Long (position 3). Each type 7 is the first header to its peer in the transmission and carries data to it, so each takes SENDER-APPROACH (interp C-1260, C-1286). Both addressees are recorded Ed4, so the block is filled with PADDING to the lowest, 0.0.1.3, with CAPABILITY (C-1154). Fixture WN 4 Long: 256 bytes and 4800 ms a block (test data).
